title.zh: 探究因内特贸易体的秘密
title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

excerpt.zh: 在发现了因内特贸易体的安息之地后，关于他们辽阔帝国仍有许多未解之谜。我们计划再一次进行调查。
excerpt.en: After having discovered the final resting place of the Inetian Traders there is still more to learn about their vast empire. We would like to investigate them one more time.

title.zh: 探究因内特贸易体的秘密
title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

texts.zh:
因内特贸易体的最后安息地似乎是一座非常高科技的空间站。他们建造这座空间站来抵抗他们自己一手造成的恶劣宇宙风暴。这座独特的居住站是因内特科技的巅峰之作，拥有惊人的宜居控制和保护系统。但即便如此先进的居住站都没能无限期地保护它们。

由于这座空间站经过千万年的衰败已经过于危险不宜居住，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以提取它的从系统中提取知识宝库。不仅如此，他们还在一个数据库中发现了因内特贸易体最重要的贸易路线，并在一台工作站上发现了更高效、对星球破坏更小的气候控制机器的精致原型。

看来至少一部分因内特贸易体的坚持没有白费，这将继续帮助我们度过风暴。
texts.en:
The final resting place of the Inetian Traders turned out to be a very high-tech space station. They had built it as a refuge against the terrible cosmic storms they had brought into existence themselves. This unique habitat is a true zenith of Inetian tech, boasting incredible habitability control and protection systems. But even that could not save them indefinitely.

As such, while the station is no longer safe to inhabit due to the eons of decay, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] were able to extract a trove of knowledge from its systems. Not only that, they also found the Inetian Traders' most important trade routes stored on a databank, and delicate prototypes of more efficient, less-planet destroying climate control machines, found simply laying upon a workstation.

It seems at least some of the Inetian Traders' tenacity has prevailed, and it will continue to help us through these storms.
